sourceText: Build a read-only script/CLI command that can prove three situations for playbook promotion learning: whether real candidates are produced, whether candidates are consumed, and whether recommendations are handled.
normalizedOutcome: Proofbound exposes a host-neutral read-only playbook_promotion_observe command with --since and --json that reports candidate generation, candidate consumption, and recommendation handling/backlog from existing learning-store records without mutating learning state or enabling automatic promotion.
acceptanceClaim: The story is accepted when playbook_promotion_observe reads playbooks, outcome events, promotion decisions, and non-deducible registry rows to report candidateGenerated, candidateConsumed, and recommendationHandling, with smoke coverage proving empty-store, explicit exposure, unexposed candidate, unhandled recommendation, handled recommendation, and read-only/non-authoritative boundaries.
